p: Pharaoh: Faith overcomes fear, and makes men bold in their calling.
hold a feast unto me in: And offer sacrifice.
make them rest from their burdens: As though you would rebel.
officers: Who were of the Israelites, and had charge to see them do their work.
Let there more work be laid: The more cruelly the tyranny rages, the nearer is God's help.
vain words: Of Moses and Aaron.
put a sword in their hand: It is a grievous things for the servants of God to be accused of evil, especially by their brethren, when they do what their duty requires.
